news.headline: Central Florida Fri Nov 27 midday: NWS Melbourne (2:50 AM discussion) — drier, cooler air moves in through Saturday, mostly precipitation-free thru Sunday afternoon; prolonged river flooding continues along the St. Johns River with all east-central Florida points in Major Flood Stage; highs low 60s north to low 70s south, lows low to mid 50s; rain chances return Monday (20-40%) and Tuesday (40-60%)

Miami construction — City Commission approved Midtown Park, a $2 billion, five-acre mixed-use district in Midtown Miami announced Nov 24: up to 924 residential units, more than 120,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail/restaurant, about 60,000 sq ft of office and nearly two acres of public parks; Phase 1 is a 28-story, 280-home tower with pricing from the low $600,000s, targeted for 2029

Northeast Florida permits Nov 27 — St. Johns County single-family permits fell 12.7% Jan-Oct 2026 vs the same months of 2025, the only decline among the four NEFBA-tracked counties (Clay +19.7%, Duval +12.8%, Nassau +6.5%); the region issued 7,860 permits Jan-Oct vs 7,622 a year earlier, with October alone up about 16% to 801
news.source: St. Johns County Living / NEFBA via Jacksonville Daily Record

news.headline: Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper bounced Thu Nov 26 — benchmark LME copper rose 1.9% to $11,867 per metric tonne as AI equities recovered, after falling about 17% over the past four weeks from September's record $14,875 per tonne; zinc jumped 3.5% to $3,511 a tonne on a smelter shutdown

HVAC — ACHR News: heat pumps rose from about 28% of new homes in 2022 to nearly 48% in partial-year 2026 in an Ekotrope/HERS dataset of more than 2.1 million rated homes, and AHRI put heat pumps at 44.7% of combined cooling equipment shipments in August 2026, up from 31% in August 2016

Markets Fri Nov 27 — U.S. futures surged as investors returned from Thanksgiving: S&P 500 futures up 1.65% to 7,314.50 and Nasdaq-100 futures up about 2.4-2.5% in early trading, with the NYSE closing early today at 1 PM ET; CME FedWatch priced a 99.4% chance of a Fed rate hike at the Dec 8-9 FOMC, lifting the target range to 4.00-4.25%

FHFA Nov 24: the 2027 conforming loan limit for one-unit properties rises to $855,400 in most of the U.S., up $22,650 (2.72%) from 2026, with a high-cost ceiling of $1,283,100; limits will be higher in all but 24 counties, reflecting the rise in average U.S. home values between Q3 2025 and Q3 2026

NBA — Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 on Wed Nov 25 (Heat now 10-7), and the Detroit Pistons beat the Orlando Magic 104-86 on Tue Nov 24; next: Heat at the New York Knicks Fri Nov 27 at 7 PM ET, Magic at the Washington Wizards Sat Nov 28 at 5 PM ET

NFL Thanksgiving Thu Nov 26 — all three games decided in the final minute: Chicago Bears 39, Detroit Lions 35; Philadelphia Eagles 39, Dallas Cowboys 38; Buffalo Bills 13, Kansas City Chiefs 10 on a 57-yard field goal as time expired; no Florida team played Thanksgiving — ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM ET, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM ET
